title: Newman 1979 limb dataset: scout_manifest seed DOI is a typo vs reference/bib
instructions: Verify the Newman & Frisch 1979 primary-source DOI against Crossref or the publisher record; do not assume the candidate's preferred DOI merely because two repo files agree.
Correct the erroneous provenance field at the narrowest source of truth and record both the old and corrected DOI plus title evidence in the fixer report.
Search for hashes or generated references inside the allowed dataset that pin the changed file; if a required update falls outside the allowlist, stop as blocked and name it.

validators.name: DOI provenance consistency
argv: import json,re,pathlib; m=json.load(open('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/scout_manifest.json')); r=json.load(open('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/limb_chondrogenesis_turing_reference.json')); b=pathlib.Path('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/paper_citations.bib').read_text(); doi='10.1126/science.462174'; assert doi in b; print(m.get('seed_doi') or m.get('territory',{}).get('seed_doi') or 'see report', doi)
